status: Authored formula and alternative-history checks only; no population or solvency forecast
limits: All histories, wages, thresholds, ages, accrual/credit/levy choices and reserve months are authored normative hypotheses, not calibrated optimal parameters.
Career cases determine proposed annual pension units, not assets owned or actuarial cash values. A contribution transfer does not price the lifetime liability.
Alternative 15000-recipient histories are not transitions, measured cohorts, or a forecast; the old 45 scheduled payment is not overwritten by these examples.
The old 228 receipts assume unchanged wages/work and full collection, not a forecast or proof that prices, work, tax and needs transfers stay unchanged.

The known 5 interest needs lawful actual payment. Administration, survivor claims, care-credit transfers, inherited accrual, basic/floor interactions and asset/claim valuation remain unknown, not zero.
Finance margins are known components before omissions, not surpluses available for the general floor. No annual margin is recorded as a willing loan or bank deposit.
Annual advance cash examples hold only one declared due date. Bank liquidity, source access, reserve replenishment, protection and actual receipt remain unverified.
Toy annuity survival curves explicitly close at 85 solely to check the common-base-age formula; no actual early/deferred quote is available without original survival/tail evidence and law.

A best-48-calendar-base cap is an explicit distribution choice: partial service amounts are prorated; a partial calendar year still occupies a calendar base slot. No minimum vesting-years cliff exists.
No new pension law is enacted, no actual people participated, and no independently qualified actuarial review or observed superiority was obtained.
Service-year contribution totals retain their original-year currency units; they are not present values, accumulated owned assets or a price for the lifetime benefit.
